text_block_list.text:
A few days after the debut race.
I went to the Mejiro family retreat
to check on Mejiro Ardan's condition, only to find—

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer-sama.
choice_data_list: Good morning.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
"You have come to see Lady Ardan, yes?
I will guide you. Right this way――"

Mejiro Ardan's nanny guided me to the woods
adjacent to the retreat, where Mejiro Ardan
was enjoying a forest bath.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, good day.
I am glad you could make it.
choice_data_list: ...How are you feeling physically?
...How is your body feeling?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: No problem. My primary physician has also confirmed that I've recovered to the state I was in before my debut race, for now.
choice_data_list: I'm glad to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Would you care to take a short walk with me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: There's something I'd like to discuss with you, just the two of us.

The place Mejiro Ardan led me to
was a hill just past a grove of trees.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "Right now," this is the watershed moment for you.
choice_data_list: Does that mean—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "...I have a fairly good idea of what my doctor told you the other day, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: He is a renowned physician whom our family takes great pride in. He has known me since childhood and is as trustworthy as my nanny.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, please assume that what he stated about me...
is entirely close to the truth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's just—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Even so. Even if my body is like this.
Even if the path ahead is as fragile as thin ice――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I will never, under any circumstances, back down.
choice_data_list: Aldan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"However, this is entirely my choice.
It is my own will...
not yours, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...I think you now understand full well
that I am a fragile, unreliable Umamusume
who collapses right at her debut race, Trainer-san."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "By walking alongside someone like me, Trainer, you...—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume so fragile, so perilous,
like an empty piece of delicate glassware—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Are you prepared for the possibility that I might break it?
choice_data_list: There is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: However, I definitely won't break it.

text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan turns an inquiring gaze toward me.
I already know the answer I need to give her.
choice_data_list: There's something I want to show you.
There's something I want you to see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Something you want me... to see...?

I held out the tablet device I had brought
to Mejiro Ardan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Are these... race rotations
and training menus...?
And with multiple variations, no less...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Could this really be—
choice_data_list: That's my resolve.
That's my resolve.

text_block_list.text:
Displayed on the tablet handed to Mejiro Ardan
were her race rotation and training menus
for the Junior Class and beyond.
And that was a compilation of every single contingency I could think of, anticipating various potential conditions for Mejiro Ardan going forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... do you understand what lies ahead for me...?
Do you comprehend what my words truly mean...?
I understand. That she is deliberately pushing me away and questioning me as a test. And that this is her form of kindness—

However, I am not seeking that kind of kindness.
What I seek is—
choice_data_list: I want to stay as Mejiro Ardan's trainer.
I want to keep being Ardan's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

Precisely because I wanted to remain her Trainer, I pondered.
What was my duty as her Trainer?
What was being asked of me?

I put the answer into words right here.
As Mejiro Ardan's Trainer—
choice_data_list: I won't let your light be extinguished.
I won't let your light fade away.

text_block_list.text:
As her trainer, I will protect Mejiro Ardan's body
so she can continue to shine in races far into the future.
And for her sake—she who lives in the "now" and gazes only at the "now"—
choice_data_list: I'll paint your "future"
I'll paint your "future"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
…………After my debut race.
The night I was brought to the convalescent facility.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I had a dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —...a dream where the sound of shattering glass echoed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The sensation of everything spilling away
from my cracked body was
vivid, and chilling—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I couldn't let go of that dream... and ended up being so rude as to test you today, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I am terribly sorry.
choice_data_list: If anything, I want to thank you for trying it out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huh—
choice_data_list: Because it helped me steel my resolve once again, too.
It helped me renew my resolve as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Please let me walk alongside you.
Please, let me walk alongside you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...No, the pleasure is mine. I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Please...
Walk this path together with me from now on—
Afterward, I ended up speaking with Mejiro Ardan's primary physician alongside her—

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
――I have understood the intentions of both
Milady and her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text: As your personal physician, I hereby grant permission for the young lady to return to the academy.
choice_data_list: Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text: However, please keep in mind that should anything happen to the young lady again in the future, this permission may be revoked.
choice_data_list: I am fully aware.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
...As an individual,
I support the path you two have chosen.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
"If there is anything you would like to consult me about,
please do not hesitate to let me know.
Well then, I shall take my leave now—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...It seems he places
his trust in you as well, Trainer.
choice_data_list: I'll do my absolute best to live up to that trust.
I'll do my best not to betray that trust.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
The same goes for me, too.

After Mejiro Ardan's nanny drove both of us
from the retreat back to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Baaya.
Thank you very much for seeing me off.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: Regarding today's matter, I have already informed the Master and Mistress, so—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I also sent a message to Father and Mother just a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As soon as I return to the dorm...
I will contact you again.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
Milady. As for the path ahead...
Please, take utmost care.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"The most grueling and arduous one of all," yes.
I shall never, ever forget that.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
My heart shall always remain with you.
May fortune favor you in battle.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: —Trainer-sama.
choice_data_list: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: "...Please, take good care of the young lady."
choice_data_list: I will protect her, no matter what

text_block_list.text: Hearing my words, Mejiro Ardan's nanny bowed deeply and took her leave without saying another word...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much
for coming to pick me up today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: So, about what we should discuss going forward—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright if I leave all the race planning
for my Junior year in your hands, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Of course. But are you sure I can decide everything?
Of course. But are you sure I can decide everything?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...Today, I have made a new resolution as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I've decided to follow the "future"
that you showed and envisioned for me, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Aldan...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Please show me the 'now'
that I ought to build upon, Trainer."

Hearing those words made me feel that Mejiro Ardan
relied on me just a little bit more
than she did before.

I want to continue supporting her like this,
knowing the desperate resolve she holds in her heart.
That feeling welled up from deep within my chest.
choice_data_list: Let's get stronger, one step at a time.

text_block_list.text:
What Mejiro Ardan needs right now
is both the physical endurance and the experience
to fight through the actual races.
During the Junior Class, I want her to build up training and gain experience in official races while keeping her pace in mind.
choice_data_list: And so, let's aim for an even brighter stage.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I suppose this could be considered
a warrior's pilgrimage, so to speak.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
“...I'll be in your care again starting tomorrow,
Trainer.”

With renewed resolve—
the Junior Class with Mejiro Ardan begins!
